question: In 1527, the Battle of Khanwa was fought between Babur and _______, the ruler of Mewar.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rana Sanga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Battle of Khanwa was fought between **Babur** and **Rana Sanga** in **1527**.
 
• **Babur** was the founder of the **Mughal Empire** in India.
 
• **Rana Sanga** was the ruler of **Mewar**, a region in present-day Rajasthan, India.
 
• The battle was part of Babur's campaign to establish his rule in India after defeating the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• Rana Sanga was a formidable opponent who united various Rajput clans against Babur.
 
• The battle was significant as it marked the consolidation of Babur's power in India and the decline of Rajput resistance.
 
• The victory at Khanwa allowed Babur to expand his empire and solidify the foundation for future Mughal rulers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prithviraj**__

 __
 
• **Prithviraj Chauhan** was a Rajput king from the Chahamana (Chauhan) dynasty.
 
• He is known for his battles against Muhammad Ghori in the late 12th century.
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan ruled the kingdom of Ajmer and Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Rana Pratap**__
 
 
• **Maharana Pratap** was another prominent ruler of Mewar, succeeding Rana Sanga.
 
• He is celebrated for his resistance against the Mughal emperor Akbar.
 
• Rana Pratap is best known for the Battle of Haldighati in 1576.
